concerns.spots: Reviewers report the patches minimizing whiteheads, draining a large pimple or papule overnight, and clearing active breakouts within one to two days; one notes a giant back pimple drained by morning and another that an emerging pimple was gone by the next morning.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers describe the patches helping with breakouts and blemishes generally, including protecting an open blemish and discouraging picking, with one calling them effective on active acne at both red and ready-to-pop stages.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports visible redness reduction within one to two hours of application.
